decision: Use the existing common selected-history read, local metadata organization and loaded-conversation export paths first. No new reproducible Farfold defect was established in this read-only pass. Do not make new model sends or all-five authentication a prerequisite for common export/search lifecycle fixes.
freshness: Listed versions and installed-auth observations are dated evidence, not newly checked installed state. No current production DB, credentials or Agent was opened. Public-source versions identify reviewed semantics, not compatibility gates.

commonPaths.search: history_search_read uses official session/load only for the explicitly selected rows, seals the acknowledged prefix, searches returned user/assistant text and reports exclusions. Existing tests already cover late updates, incomplete markers and cancellation; do not repeat them just for five new labels.
commonPaths.organization: session_meta_rename/pin/archive operate Farfold-owned index metadata. Lack of official native rename/export is not a blocker for these controls; deletion and native archival remain separate.
commonPaths.export: P35 means a clearly scoped archive of loaded content and explicitly selected attachments, not a native resumable Agent session. Upstream display filtering must not be hidden by a claim of full native history.
commonPaths.notifications: success_notification registers a live request on its actual thread and requires end_turn plus no failed/in-flight tool or unresolved state. History replay is not new completion. Official declaration and local code do not establish macOS delivery/sound/click; P47/P48 actual system checks remain separate.

agents.reviewedEvidence: Historical initialize declares load/list/delete. Official CLI docs expose resume/continue and ATIF --export, but --export runs with the CLI session and is not established as a bounded read-only existing-history API.
agents.actualPrior: 2026-10-06 installed c42 evidence includes load and one prompt with non-error ordered responses and root-observed complete expected message; content-free metadata does not prove all transcript fields or current account/model.
agents.next: Use an already owned indexed conversation only after root confirms current owner/config and idle state; selected load/search/export can be checked with zero new prompt. Do not repeat old auth_required as the current fact.
agents.gap: Complete replay and official export field coverage; actual system notification routing for this Agent remain unverified.

agents.reviewedEvidence: Historical official daemon declares load/list/resume. New primary documentation exposes droid search --json with kind/session-count/hit-count/context limits. The documented search scope is across local sessions; no precise session selector or JSON source-location contract was established.
agents.actualPrior: 2026-10-24 installed one-request sample showed UI 401 and unknown outcome with sending paused; it did not establish a terminal or account diagnosis. Do not resume or retry that request.
agents.next: Keep selected session/load as the existing limited path. A separate narrow official-CLI search audit can check installed command shape, exact selected scope, cache side effects and stable JSON identities before any implementation; no --reindex or model exec is proposed.
agents.gap: Do not scan all local history then filter it as a substitute for the user-selected scope; no official CLI call was run here.

agents.reviewedEvidence: Historical load/replay implementation exists; list was undeclared/method_not_found. Official /export and /resume CLI commands are not automatically ACP methods. authenticate may first log out, so it is not a read-only availability probe.
agents.actualPrior: 2026-10-24 exact-reply formal sample completed and was visibly idle. It proves neither current account nor backend model. The 2026-11-07 queue-edit/cold-continue record reviewed here is Goose, not CodeBuddy, and is not used to promote CodeBuddy coverage.
agents.next: Prefer the already owned successful indexed sample for zero-send selected read and loaded export once present/current ownership is verified. Local rename/pin/archive does not require session/list.
agents.gap: No new current-state, cold-full-transcript or system notification evidence in this pass.

agents.reviewedEvidence: Official v0.5.21 source declares load/resume/close/delete but not list despite an unstable_listSessions implementation. load requires persisted task runtime config and existing owned worktree, restores settings and writes session runtime metadata. ACP load replays after subscribing.
agents.actualPrior: 2026-10-24 formal sample did produce expected reply/completion/idle; the declared zero-tool expectation failed because one Task Completed step was visible. This was not a no-reply/auth failure.
agents.sourceRisks: replayLoadedSessionHistory can catch a saved-message read failure and return, and catches per-message translation errors; the event forwarder does not await connection.sessionUpdate. These are source-level limits, not a new reproduced Farfold failure. Keep acknowledged-prefix/returned-field scope and failed/empty guards.
agents.next: Use a known indexed owned sample whose cwd/runtime still exist; do not fabricate list capability or overwrite missing settings. Validate late/incomplete replay via existing common tests; new formal read requires root to check the exact sample first.
agents.gap: No zero-message completeness proof or current official list availability was established.

agents.reviewedEvidence: Official cli-v3.0.65 load replay awaits each sessionUpdate, but first projects display messages, removes display-only errors and synthetic user continuation, converts some nonimage media to a text description and flattens tool outputs. Historical initialize exposes load, not list.
agents.actualPrior: 2026-10-06 initial formal sample accepted new/config then first prompt returned internal error; no expected reply. This is more specific than a generic missing-account claim, and is not retried.
agents.next: Keep saved-selection restore guards and scoped loaded exports. The complete official replay source is now cached for a controlled fixture if a changed common path needs verification; no synthetic fixture would count as official acceptance.
agents.gap: Current provider/model selection and an owned readable real history were not rechecked; no full-fidelity media/native-session export claim.

priorityNextAction: Finish the already delegated common export-dialog/host lifecycle repair and its bounded tests; it applies to the five Agents without new per-Agent UI or model calls.

For real selected-history/search/export, choose one currently present, owned, previously successful CodeBuddy or Dirac sample after closed-state/current-owner checks. One bounded session/load, no prompt/set/auth; compare acknowledged returned body with exported scope; metadata edits remain local. Missing/corrupt history or config drift stays explicit and does not cause newSession or retry.
Only if native search beyond selected-load is needed, narrow-audit Factory droid search JSON and scope/cache contract. Documentation alone is not enough to add its launch route.
stopConditions: Unexpected authentication/config rewrite or model selection mismatch: do not continue/retry.
Unsupported official list does not trigger guessed private database reads.
Load errors/late prefixes or absent scope evidence never become complete-history claims.
No new app/Agent/model/OS experiments are authorized by this report.
